div.head: Ine 59.1
div.ab: Mon sceal simle to beregafole agyfen æt anum wyrhtan VI pundwæga.
Mon sceal simle to beregafole agifan æt anum wyrhtan VI wæga.
Mon sceal simle to beregafule agifan æt anum þyrtan VI pundþęga.
Mon sceal simle to beregafole agifan æt anum wyrhtan VI wæga.
One should always give as “barley rent” 6 weys for each worker.
For every labourer a man has he shall always pay six weys [of barley] as ' barley-rent.'
As barley-rent, six weys must always be given for each labourer.
Man soll jedesmal [jährlich dem Grundherrn] als Gerstenzins von einem Landarbeiter 6 Wispel [Gerste] abgeben.
One is always to give [the landlord, yearly] as barley-rent 6 weys [of barley] for each labourer.
